title: Generation worker await duration
description: Mean and maximum generation-worker waits for prompts, admission slots, queues, model calls and environments. Rising model waits suggest serving pressure; slot waits with a full buffer can be expected backpressure. The mean divides wait seconds by await counts; requires trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No rollout-span observations. Check trainer.rollout_spans and the selected Job/Execution.
